name: diff_snapshots
description: Compare two captured pages in the same scope; old revision may differ, newest must be live.

name: capture_snapshot
description: Capture a bounded live query page; expires or invalidates after model changes.

name: read_snapshot
description: Read captured rows only while document, revision and scope remain valid.

name: preview_batch
description: Validate a batch in rolled-back transactions and return a document-bound plan.

name: apply_plan
description: Apply a fresh one-use plan atomically; verifies typed writes and optionally saves.

name: set_window_sills
description: Prepare a verified plan setting sill height on filtered windows. Apply with apply_plan.

name: assign_marks
description: Prepare deterministic marks on filtered doors/windows; existing marks preserved by default.

name: tag_rooms
description: Prepare room tags on enclosed filtered rooms, skipping rooms already tagged in the view.

name: create_test_project
description: Create and activate a new project from the configured architectural template in the local test folder. Requires explicit PID at Revit home; never overwrites existing files.

name: discover_instances
description: Find the single open instance matching the configured project path; read only.

name: get_project_state
description: Compact local decisions, historical baseline and pending items; not a live model snapshot.

name: save_project
description: Save the verified project outside a transaction.

name: run_workflow
description: Remove tags in one allowed category, optional exact source_id, verify and save in one Revit call. Max 250; dependency deletion refused.

name: ping_revit
description: Health and Revit version; no model changes.

name: get_active_document
description: Active document and session token required for writes.

name: get_project_info
description: Project information and active view; optional fixed-path PNG export. Saving uses save_project.

name: get_levels
description: Levels sorted by elevation, at most 100.

name: query_elements
description: Query filtered Revit elements; projection, view/selection, type/family, spatial box and dimensional predicates.

name: create_elements
description: Batch levels, walls, hosted doors/windows, rooms and tags. Explicit types/hosts required. source_id stored in RVT prevents duplicates.

name: modify_elements
description: Modify name or level elevation_m. Stable UniqueId preferred.

name: delete_elements
description: Delete explicit IDs; deletion of dependent elements is refused and rolled back.

name: execute_batch
description: One Revit round trip for max 250 create/modify/delete actions. Atomic default; independent commits valid actions.

name: validate_elements
description: Check existence and compact identity/elevation for max 250 IDs.

name: get_last_errors
description: Last 20 compact errors; current add-in session only.
